# GEOK Documentation

> GEOK is the open-source GEO and AI visibility tracking platform. These docs cover setup, configuration, and deployment.

## What is GEOK?

GEOK monitors how your brand appears in real AI products — ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Overview — using browser automation against the actual product UIs. It captures inline citations, ranked recommendations, brand framing, and competitor co-mentions that never appear in raw model API output.

It is open source (MIT), self-hosted, and free to run. All data stays on your own machine or VPS.
